summary: 10.0.41.01 Document Date Formatting Parity, ConfigManager Global Fallback, and Multi-line Email Message Body Expansion
highlights: 1. Document Date Formatting Parity: Guaranteed custom date formats (e.g., DD/MM/YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD) set in company settings propagate consistently into all PDF renders and previews.
2. Server ConfigManager Global Cache: Persistent settings synchronization preventing uninitialized thread-local fallbacks during background and async document generation.
3. Multi-line Email Message Body: Expanded email transmission modal textarea height to show complete multi-line email messages with responsive vertical resizing.
4. Universal Lightbox PDF Studio: Unified lightbox preview and transmission flow across Quotation, Sales, and Returns.
